FICTIONAL REPORTING ORDINANCE — VERSION EFFECTIVE 1 JANUARY 2026

Section 8

From 1 January 2026 through 31 March 2026, both dates inclusive, an operator that exceeds 100 reportable events shall submit a notice no later than 10 calendar days after the threshold is exceeded. This paragraph does not apply to an undertaking with fewer than 10 employees.

This text is a synthetic temporal fixture. It is not legal authority.
